refactor: make translation-unit local functions static

These functions are only used within the file that defines them, and
have no declaration elsewhere, so -Wmissing-prototypes (clang) and
-Wmissing-declarations (GCC) warn about them. Give them internal
linkage.

fail_test_if_executed() is [[maybe_unused]], because TRACEPOINT discards
its arguments when tracing is disabled.
